_about: Speed slider curve, pinned for BOTH implementations: custom_components/iledclock/retime.py (pace_for_speed / speed_for_pace) and frontend/src/lib/playback.ts (paceForSpeed / speedForPace). pace(s) = MAX * (MIN / MAX) ** (1 - s / 100) frames a second for slider position s in 1..100 (position 0 is Still: one picture, no pace). MAX = 1000 / (7 units * 1.5 ms) = 95.238095, MIN = 0.5. Change the constants in hardware.py and BOTH test suites must be updated together with the TypeScript copy.
